items.q: How old do I need to be to get cannabis delivery in Vauxhall?
items.a_html: New Jersey's adult-use cannabis law requires you to be 21 or older to place a delivery order. Age is verified when you set up your Lady L account, and your driver will check your ID at the door before the handoff is completed. No exceptions apply.

items.q: Which IDs does Lady L accept for delivery?
items.a_html: Any valid, government-issued photo ID works. Driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports all qualify, and out-of-state IDs are accepted, too. Your ID must be uploaded to your Lady L account before your first order, and you’ll need to have the physical ID on hand when your driver arrives.

items.q: Do I also need a medical card to get cannabis delivered in Vauxhall?
items.a_html: No medical card is required. Lady L is an adult-use dispensary open to any customer 21 or older. A confirmed Lady L account and a valid ID are all you need to place your Vauxhall weed delivery order.

items.q: What's the purchase limit for a single order?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law allows us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis per transaction. That can include any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes apply to cannabis in New Jersey?
items.a_html: New Jersey adult-use cannabis purchases include a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax, where applicable, and a $ 2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). All of these apply equally to delivery orders, and every applicable charge is itemized at checkout before you confirm.
